name: What permits are required for a second-story addition in Burbank?

mainEntity.name: What permits are required for a second-story addition in Burbank?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a second-story addition in Burbank, you will need a range of permits from the City of Burbank Building Division. These typically include building permits for structural changes, electrical permits, plumbing permits, and mechanical permits. Depending on the project's scope, you might also require planning approvals related to zoning, setbacks, and design review. Our team handles all necessary permit applications and ensures full compliance with local regulations.
